shots.purpose: satu generate 10 s, tiga hard cut pencurian HP di kafe malam. Cut 1 untuk beat hook; cut 2-3 masuk library untuk video HP dicuri berikutnya (beat clock di video uji ini register type).
shots.motion:
Vertical 9:16 video, documentary realism, looks like real security-camera and phone footage. One continuous night at a small open-air cafe, same person in a dark hoodie, same warm orange streetlight and the same low-light sensor noise and grain in every cut. Faces indistinct and not identifiable in every cut. The phone screen is completely black, dead and switched off for the entire clip; no clock, icons, text, lock screen or interface ever appears on it. No text, no watermark, no captions.
[0-3.3s] High fixed security-camera view, wide lens with slight barrel distortion, static camera, completely locked off, never pans or zooms: a phone lies on a cafe table next to an iced coffee; a hooded figure walking past slides it off the table into a pocket without stopping.
[3.3-6.4s] Hard cut to a close-up of gloved hands in a dim doorway, slight handheld shake: the thumb holds the side button of the phone; the black screen stays black.
[6.4-10s] Hard cut to a narrow wet alley, static camera, completely locked off: the hooded figure seen from behind walks away into the dark and turns the corner.

cuts.desc: CCTV: HP diambil dari meja kafe
